ios.release_notes: Accent-insensitive airport search (Zurich, Cancun, Sao Paulo). Clearer survey path when a trip is on your phone but not yet on research servers (Share or update). More reliable research upload and survey error messages.

android.release_notes: Production release on Google Play. Point reminders, trip history chart, Android 15 compatibility, and cleaner Info tab. Free during our introductory launch period.
